evidenceNotes: The official property site linked to Simplebooking. The exact result page confirmed 22-29 October 2026, two adults, seven nights, DKK, a room that permits two adults, room-only basis, public access, and included taxes. The protocol selects the lowest comparable public standard rate, so the non-refundable rate is retained with its cancellation basis.
